{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
sales = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Parse revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter for converted customers
converted_customers = sales[sales['converted'] == 1]

# Filter out missing age (age == -1)
valid_age_converted = converted_customers[converted_customers['customer_age'] != -1]

# Compute mean age
mean_age_converted = valid_age_converted['customer_age'].mean()

# Print required values
print(f"mean_age_converted = {mean_age_converted}")
print(f"valid_age_converted.shape[0] = {valid_age_converted.shape[0]}")
print(f"converted_customers.shape[0] = {converted_customers.shape[0]}")"}
